howItWorks.title: How Swiss Mail works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to send a professional letter.
howItWorks.step1Detail: Tell us what kind of letter you need. We guide the structure and prepare a formal letter in the correct Swiss format.
howItWorks.step2Detail: Review every section of your letter. Edit the sender, recipient, body, and attachments. Add your signature if needed.
howItWorks.step3Detail: Choose standard or registered delivery. Pay securely with card or TWINT. We print your letter on quality paper and hand it to Swiss Post.
howItWorks.faq1a: Standard letters are typically delivered within 1–3 business days within Switzerland.
howItWorks.faq2a: Registered letters include tracking. Standard letters do not include tracking, but delivery is reliable through Swiss Post.
howItWorks.faq3a: No. You can draft and send a letter as a guest. We give you a link to resume your draft if you leave.
howItWorks.faq4q: What payment methods do you accept?
howItWorks.faq4a: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and TWINT.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.subtitle: Clear totals upfront
pricing.pricingUnavailableBody: Pricing information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
pricing.serviceCardTitle: What Swiss Mail adds on top
pricing.serviceCardBody: The exact charge is always the live ePost quote for your real draft plus our Swiss Mail service fee. The public page keeps that honest by using one documented reference scenario instead of guessing.
pricing.summaryCardBody: These public totals use one printed page, one physical A4 sheet, one C5 envelope, and the current ePost dispatch mapping configured for standard and registered letters.
pricing.checkoutTruth: Checkout recalculates the exact total from the live provider quote for your specific draft, page count, attachments, and delivery type. We do not charge from this page's reference scenario.
pricing.providerCardBody: Verified from ePost's public Digital Letter pricing calculator on April 3, 2026. These inputs explain the per-page and dispatch components behind the reference totals.
pricing.providerVatNote: ePost publishes these B2B reference rates excluding VAT. Swiss Mail confirms the final customer total before payment.
pricing.referenceCardBody: Reference scenario: {printedPages} printed page, {physicalSheets} physical A4 sheet, {envelopeFormat} envelope, {standardPostage} for standard mail, and {registeredPostage} for registered mail.
pricing.referenceCardFallback: The reference scenario is currently unavailable.
pricing.referenceScenarioInline: Reference scenario: {printedPages} printed page, {physicalSheets} physical A4 sheet, {envelopeFormat} envelope.
pricing.verifiedOnLabel: Verified against official ePost public inputs on {date}.
pricing.comparisonBody: We keep the wording conservative. If the provider cannot give a stronger guarantee or tracking promise, we do not invent one on the pricing page.
pricing.comparisonTrackingStandard: Only if the provider supplies it
pricing.comparisonTrackingRegistered: Only if the provider supplies it
pricing.comparisonConfirmationRegistered: Stronger wording only after provider confirmation
pricing.includedCardTitle: What the Swiss Mail service covers
pricing.includedCardBody: The service fee is not just postage. It covers the full drafting-to-dispatch flow.
pricing.includedFormatting: Swiss-style formatting and final PDF generation
pricing.includedRendering: Provider submission, reconciliation, and payment handling
pricing.excludedCardTitle: What this service does not promise
pricing.excludedCardBody: We keep this section explicit so the pricing page does not oversell the product.
pricing.excludedGuaranteedOutcome: Guaranteed delivery outcome or guaranteed tracking
pricing.faqBody: Short answers to the questions that matter before checkout.
pricing.faq1q: Do I pay if my letter is rejected?
pricing.faq1a: If the provider rejects dispatch before payment capture, the authorization is cancelled or released. We do not keep a settled charge for a rejected letter.
pricing.faq2a: Refund handling follows the real payment and dispatch state. We only call a refund complete once Stripe confirms it.
pricing.faq3a: Not at MVP. Pricing is per letter and shown clearly before payment.
pricing.faq4q: Is VAT included in the prices shown?
pricing.faq4a: Swiss Mail checkout totals are shown in CHF before payment. The ePost unit reference on this page is presented as ePost publishes it: excluding VAT.
pricing.vatIncludedNote: Swiss Mail customer totals are shown in CHF and confirmed before payment.
pricing.ctaBandTitle: Try it. You only pay when you are ready to send.
pricing.ctaBandBody: Draft, review, and confirm the exact total before checkout.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Answers and contact
help.faq1q: How do I write a letter?
help.faq1a: Start by clicking 'Write a letter'. Describe your situation, review the draft, and send it when it is ready.
help.faq2a: Standard letters are typically delivered within 1–3 business days within Switzerland.
help.faq3a: Registered letters include tracking. Standard letters do not include tracking, but delivery is reliable through Swiss Post.
help.faq4q: What if something goes wrong with my payment?
help.faq4a: If a payment fails, you can retry at checkout. If you were charged but something went wrong, contact us and we'll investigate immediately.
help.faq5q: Can I edit my letter after paying?
help.faq5a: Once payment is confirmed and the letter is submitted for dispatch, it cannot be edited. Review your letter carefully before checkout.
help.faq6q: What file formats can I attach?
help.faq6a: You can add supporting files during drafting. The exact formats and attachment count depend on the active postal dispatch path shown in the app.
help.faq7a: No. You can draft and send a letter as a guest. We give you a link to resume your draft if you leave.
help.faq8q: What payment methods do you accept?
help.faq8a: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and TWINT.
help.contactDescription: If your question isn't answered above, reach out to us.
help.contactResponseTime: We aim to respond within one business day.
